_doc: Self-service itinerary fixes, no rebuild needed. Edit this file on GitHub (mobile app or github.com), commit to main; the family page and Jerusha's page fetch it fresh on every online load and lay it over their built-in schedule. Shape: voyages.<id> = {note, title, start, end, days:{'<dayNumber>':{any day field: loc, pos, dock, wx:{hi,lo,txt}, plan:[..], hist, poi:[..], booked:[..], desc}}}. Voyage ids: getaway, world-america-dec, anthem-alaska. Only include what changed - everything else stays as built. Offline devices show the built-in schedule until back online. Limitation: map route lines and pins don't move via overrides; text, hours and plans do.
